milestone: Ecommerce V1.2 — validated on single-instance production topology
title: V1.2 payment state machine is not production-certified
claim: The payment state machine is substantially validated on one CFOS process against real PocketBase and the production webhook ABI. Late success after expiry does not commit inventory.
notClaimed: Production certification. A production-like webhook ABI is not a real PSP integration. An in-process lock is not a distributed consistency mechanism.
abstraction: Storefront → Commerce ABI → Payment State Machine → Payment Adapter (Razorpay | Stripe)

gate1_realPsp.name: Real PSP authenticity
required: Customer → Commerce checkout → provider sandbox → real signed webhook
Commerce webhook verifier (cryptographic provider signature, not ABI secret alone)

gate2_distributedCas.name: Distributed compare-and-set
gate2_distributedCas.required: Persistent conditional transition; database is the authority
gate2_distributedCas.target: UPDATE orders SET payment_status='paid', payment_revision=payment_revision+1 WHERE id=? AND payment_status='payment_pending' AND payment_revision=?
gate2_distributedCas.forbidden: Do not treat AtomicPaymentGate / withOrderPaymentLock as the distributed primitive

2_provider.note: A production-like webhook ABI is not the same thing as a real PSP integration.
2_provider.razorpayStripeSandbox: NOT RUN — tenant gateway_not_ready; PaymentAdapter is interface-only; no provider-signed payload receiver

3_distributed.note: An in-process lock is not a distributed consistency mechanism.
3_distributed.singleInstanceConcurrentHttp: PASS — one inventory commit; expiry+success after TTL is pending + lateSuccess + stockΔ=0
3_distributed.multiReplica: NOT EXERCISABLE — service publishes host-mode *:8791, replicas=1

results.cancelledPayment: PASS (mark-failed stand-in; no cancel route on this SHA)
results.invalidWebhookSignature: PASS HTTP 401 (ABI secret, not PSP signature)

concurrency.databaseCas: REQUIRED — PocketBase PATCH is not compare-and-set

harness.note: Green tests do not lower the certification bar.

nextMilestone: Prove two independent processes cannot corrupt payment/inventory state (Gate 2), then real PSP-signed webhooks (Gate 1). Then certify. Then main.
